value.hook: Open before changing registration ancestry brakes or Copilot closed-row retry decisions.
value.title: Registration brakes must follow the resolved launch

sections.name: body
sections.value:
#267's descendant-only brake missed an ordinary registration: HTTP resolved the submitted child to the Copilot loader, an ANCESTOR of the registered CLI. #269 adds the reverse ancestry check. Test the resolver-to-brake composition with the real loader/CLI/shell tree, not only a hand-selected process: #269's fixture injects native_claim and does not exercise HTTP/tmux resolution. Own-id/supersedes and same-conversation exemptions preserve continuity; these are refusal brakes, not authentication. Cost is <=64 ADDED parent reads per examined non-exempt same-pane row per registration, <=128 including the existing forward walk; zero new launches.

#270 adds another incarnation trap: own-id tombstone alone cannot mean stop, because revive can start before its fresh prebind is written. Final logic stops only when the closed row matches this launch's spawn_id; without PIJ_SPAWN_ID, native-session OR PID-plus-process-start correlation applies. Another spawn id remains retryable. /restart inherits spawn_id, so a genuinely closed launch still stops. Launch correlation does not grant caller authority.

Anchors: #269 at 9ec68d399c7cba523beece047c0c9c0152598dc5, registration.rs:747-809,2999-3053; #270 at e385e0e2540962d9d6add6d92a061789adbfa1c6, .copilot/extensions/pij/store.mjs:486-510, extension.test.mjs:1309-1408. Reviews were static with exact-head CI verified; no local builds, mutants or live lifecycle probes were run. Do not upgrade fixture coverage into live proof.

magicWand: a deterministic HTTP-resolution-to-registration fixture reproducing the loader/CLI topology before asserting the brake.
